desc: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHaste00000]{Haste} spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.
This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.
name: potion of speed
